note: Edit this file, then run tools/radio.sh (about 4.5 minutes with cached audio). Each source is a file stem in data/audio/src. Only public: true goes to the public site; only page: true goes to the private page. Every track MUST name a key from credits in its credit field. Optional credit_overrides replace individual fields. Credits travel with the song: moving the whole track object needs no other edit. Each resolved credit needs by, licence, source, date and text. text is the displayed attribution with one {dials} placeholder; identical texts are grouped. Keep required names, tools, licence terms and geography intact. At most one station has start: true; just_start names the Just Drive starting dial. See tools/RADIO.md.

suno.text: The songs on {dials} are the author’s own, made with Suno.

bach-ishizaka.by: J. S. Bach, played by Kimiko Ishizaka (piano)
bach-ishizaka.text: The piano on {dials} is J. S. Bach, played by Kimiko Ishizaka: the Open Goldberg Variations and the Open Well-Tempered Clavier, given to the public domain (CC0).
